name: Morning Run
description: A refreshing run in the morning

exercises.name: Warm-up Jog
exercises.instructions: Start with a light jog to warm up your muscles.

exercises.name: Interval Sprints
exercises.instructions: Alternate between sprinting for 30 seconds and walking for 1 minute.

exercises.name: Cool-down Walk
exercises.instructions: Finish with a slow walk to cool down.
